action.question: How should the repay endpoint handle shares > outstanding?

questions.question: How should the repay endpoint handle shares > outstanding?

options.label: Reject overpayment (Recommended)
options.description: Throw InvalidArgumentException when shares > outstanding; controller flashes error like 'Cannot repay 275 shares against a line with 270 outstanding.' No transaction is created. Forces the user to enter a correct amount; matches the existing 'positive shares' / 'paid_off line' validation style. Update the existing test to expect rejection.

options.label: Cap REP at outstanding
options.description: Clamp the REP transaction's shares value to $line->outstanding_shares (e.g. 275 → 270). Line still goes paid_off, but BOR/REP balance. Keeps the existing test's spirit (overpayment accepted) but corrects the recorded amount. Flash a warning that the excess was discarded.

options.label: Both: reject in service, with override flag
options.description: Default to rejection, but accept an `allow_overpay=true` flag that caps. Lets future flows (e.g. consolidation across lines) opt in. More surface area for one bug.
